name: net_enemy_census_transition08
description: Read-only diagnostic of the strict transition route through transition08. Preserves all earlier route/checks, then collects three bounded independently checked native actor-list, spawn-cache and controller snapshots per peer before the original strict hash check. Collection is not parity acceptance; incomplete reads cannot prove absence. The original strict check remains and may fail after evidence is saved.

steps.expr: saved['hash_initial']['epoch'] == saved['initial']['epoch'] and all(row['location'] == saved['initial']['instances'][peer]['location'] for peer, row in saved['hash_initial']['instances'].items())
steps.message: fresh hash samples crossed the settled transition epoch or location at initial
